title: Cho-Han (丁半)
description: Traditional Japanese dice game. Bet whether the total sum of two dice is Even (Cho) or Odd (Han).

actionHandlers.cho: if (state.points < 50) return alert('Insufficient points'); state.points -= 50; const sum = Math.floor(Math.random()*6)+1 + Math.floor(Math.random()*6)+1; if (sum % 2 === 0) { state.points += 100; document.getElementById('chohan-res').innerText = 'Sum is ' + sum + ' (EVEN)! You won 100 pts!'; } else { document.getElementById('chohan-res').innerText = 'Sum is ' + sum + ' (ODD). House wins!'; } updatePointsDisplay();
actionHandlers.han: if (state.points < 50) return alert('Insufficient points'); state.points -= 50; const sum = Math.floor(Math.random()*6)+1 + Math.floor(Math.random()*6)+1; if (sum % 2 !== 0) { state.points += 100; document.getElementById('chohan-res').innerText = 'Sum is ' + sum + ' (ODD)! You won 100 pts!'; } else { document.getElementById('chohan-res').innerText = 'Sum is ' + sum + ' (EVEN). House wins!'; } updatePointsDisplay();
